title: Start here — HTTPS Server v0.4.4
summary: Small native ooRexx HTTPS/HTTP/1.1 server. RxSock owns TCP/network I/O; OpenSSL supplies TLS through Foreign Runtime. Python is not on the runtime path. v0.4.4 retains memory BIO transport and bounded pre-TLS admission.
invariants: RxSock is sole accepted-socket descriptor owner.
OpenSSL never receives the accepted socket descriptor.
Foreign Runtime/OpenSSL calls are serialized through one short native lane while network waits occur outside it.
TLS minimum is 1.2; TLS 1.3 is supported.
